interpretations: Playlist-level track count = number of PlaylistTrack rows per playlist, with playlists lacking rows counted as 0; average = total track entries ÷ number of rows in Playlist; show the top 10 by count ÷ average
Playlist-level track count = number of distinct TrackIds per playlist (same as row count given the composite primary key); average over all playlists including zero-count ones; top 10 by ratio
Average computed as a true decimal (floating-point) mean across all playlists, ratio = count ÷ average, unrounded
Average computed with integer division (truncated), then ratio = count ÷ that truncated average
Ratio computed with integer division of count by average, truncating the result
Ties at the 10th ratio cut off arbitrarily, returning exactly 10 rows
Ties at the 10th ratio all included, possibly returning more than 10 rows
Ties in ratio broken by playlist id ascending
Ties in ratio broken by playlist id descending
Ties in ratio left in unspecified order
Playlists with identical names but different ids treated as separate playlists, identified by id
Playlists with identical names grouped together and treated as one playlist
Ratio is NULL when the average is zero or undefined (e.g., no playlists or all counts zero), and those rows are placed last in the sort
Rows with NULL ratio excluded rather than placed last
Output columns: playlist id, track count, ratio, in that order
Output also includes playlist name in addition to id, count and ratio
Sorting by ratio descending is applied before selecting the top 10, so the result is the 10 highest ratios in descending order
Top 10 selected by highest ratio, but final display re-sorted differently (e.g., by playlist id)
Playlists with zero tracks included in the average denominator but, having ratio 0, unlikely to appear in the top 10
Average computed only over playlists that have at least one track (excluding zero-count playlists from the average)
Average computed as the mean of PlaylistTrack row counts per playlist, using only playlists present in PlaylistTrack, while ratios are still shown for all playlists
queries:
SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist) FROM PlaylistTrack) AS ratio
FROM Playlist p
LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT p.Name, CAST(COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS REAL) / (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist) FROM PlaylistTrack) AS ratio
FROM Playlist p
LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS cnt
  FROM Playlist p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
)
SELECT PlaylistId, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM counts) AS ratio
FROM counts;
SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SUM(Milliseconds) / COUNT(*)) AS ratio FROM Track
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) / AVG(Total) AS INTEGER) FROM Invoice;
SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10;
